name: Pull Request
promise: The portfolio as a pull request to the reader's team, read as a review page.
description: A review page titled for the reader's team: the conversation is About, the commits are the record, each claim a passing check with its source, the works are files changed as diffs with review notes pinned to their lines, and the merge box is Contact.

studio.signature: A pull request to your team

sources.source: The proof of concept for issue #270 (gist 133fd86d948cccff62f6bf89eaab718b)
sources.note: Its review page, rebuilt on the v3 records: the branches and title, vertical tabs with a file tree and a Viewed bar, the description and timeline, commits by year with short hashes, checks with sources, files as unified or split diffs with pinned notes, and the merge box.

sources.source: The proof of concept's deep merge green, Charter and PT Mono
sources.note: Colour and type are the appearance's: the composition reads the positive and danger roles for added and removed lines, the body role for what people wrote and the code role for what machines print.

sources.source: The proof of concept's drafted before and after lines and case study
sources.note: The composition writes none of the owner's words: a work with a challenge and outcomes reads as its before and after, any other as a new file, until a content extension gives each work its own.
